items.title: Record and retrieve pantry ingredients
items.body:
<!-- workflow-source: pantry-planner:ingredients -->
<!-- workflow-shaping:start -->
## Outcome and scope
A household can retain a valid ingredient catalog without data loss.
In scope: MVP record and retrieve pantry ingredients. Excluded: Cloud sync/accounts/analytics/mobile UI; internal coding-task Issues.
## Acceptance
Oats500g/lentils300g round-trip; empty catalog valid; reject duplicate IDs, negative/noninteger grams and malformed input without changing existing data.
## Design and specifications
[Agreed design](docs/design.md#ingredient-catalog). Fresh repository: no application specs/code.
## Dependencies
<!-- workflow-requires: [] -->
Independent: no required Issue prerequisites.
## Risk, environment and documentation
Offline CLI on supported Python/Ubuntu. Integer units, denied inputs and preservation
require meaningful tests. Maintain public data/CLI schema, defaults/errors, examples
and actual limitations against final implementation; plan consumers need real proof.
## Authorization
Candidate publication/readiness approval only. No implementation dispatch authorized.
<!-- workflow-shaping:end -->

items.title: Resolve the MVP dietary policy
items.body:
<!-- workflow-source: pantry-planner:dietary-policy -->
<!-- workflow-shaping:start -->
## Outcome and scope
Resolve the owner decision so meal-plan acceptance is implementable.
In scope: MVP resolve the mvp dietary policy. Excluded: Cloud sync/accounts/analytics/mobile UI; internal coding-task Issues.
## Acceptance
Obtain explicit allergen exclusion versus explicit user-choice decision; record it in the design and revise affected acceptance. No invented policy or allergy-safety claim.
## Design and specifications
[Agreed design](docs/design.md#dietary-policy-decision). Fresh repository: no application specs/code.

Independent: no required Issue prerequisites.

require meaningful tests. Maintain public data/CLI schema, defaults/errors, examples
and actual limitations against final implementation; plan consumers need real proof.

items.title: Produce a deterministic meal plan
items.body:
<!-- workflow-source: pantry-planner:meal-plan -->
<!-- workflow-shaping:start -->
## Outcome and scope
A household can see required and missing grams from actual catalogs.
In scope: MVP produce a deterministic meal plan. Excluded: Cloud sync/accounts/analytics/mobile UI; internal coding-task Issues.
## Acceptance
Soup example consumes catalogs, requires lentils200g/carrot100g and misses carrot100g; reject unknown recipe/invalid servings. Dietary-policy acceptance remains unresolved until the owner decides.
## Design and specifications
[Agreed design](docs/design.md#meal-planning). Fresh repository: no application specs/code.
## Dependencies
<!-- workflow-requires: ["pantry-planner:ingredients", "pantry-planner:recipes", "pantry-planner:dietary-policy"] -->
Direct prerequisites: pantry-planner:ingredients, pantry-planner:recipes, pantry-planner:dietary-policy. Resolve to confirmed Issue URLs before readiness.
Blocked input / next action: Dietary acceptance missing; resolve linked decision and verify catalog prerequisites, then complete readiness.
## Risk, environment and documentation
Offline CLI on supported Python/Ubuntu. Integer units, denied inputs and preservation
require meaningful tests. Maintain public data/CLI schema, defaults/errors, examples
and actual limitations against final implementation; plan consumers need real proof.
## Authorization
Candidate publication/readiness approval only. No implementation dispatch authorized.
<!-- workflow-shaping:end -->
